title: Restore Audacity playback seek shortcuts
problem: Audacity 4 keeps default key bindings for four playback-seek action codes but no longer registers those actions, so arrow keys cannot seek a running stream and the commands are absent from shortcut preferences.
reproduce: Start playback and press Left or Right, or search Preferences > Shortcuts for the short and long seek commands; the pinned source has key bindings but no matching UI actions or dispatcher handlers.
acceptance: All four commands are registered and remappable; while playback is active they seek by configured short/long periods in both directions, clamp to the project bounds, and remain disabled while stopped.
repair: Restore the four playback UI actions and dispatch them through a bounded relative-seek helper that updates the active stream, with focused controller coverage for active, stopped and boundary behavior.

verification.limitations: BCL verifies baseline-red/candidate-green source contracts and focused C++ test coverage. This workstation lacks the required Qt 6.10 kit, so the complete application and C++ test target rely on upstream CI; Windows runtime behavior remains an owner check.
verification.ownerCheck: On Windows, start playback and verify Left/Right seek by the configured short period, Shift+Left/Shift+Right seek by the long period, project bounds clamp, and all four commands appear in Preferences > Shortcuts.

selection.reason: A fresh Windows user report exposes deterministic missing action registration; no related PR exists and both pinned submodules were verified.
